text:
jamie: FYI we're updating metering and invoice rounding rules effective 2026-09-01. Short summary below; we'll push console banners + customer emails next week.

priya: TL;DR: 1) Metering precision will change from per-token integer to 0.1-token increments for billing (reduces rounding skew). 2) Minimum billable increment: 0.1 token. 3) Invoices will show pre-rounded token usage + post-rounding billed tokens and a rounding_adj line if > $0.50. 4) Rate-limit enforcement unchanged.

callum: Dev notes: metering change requires updates to usage-collector and billing pipeline. We'll add fields `raw_tokens`, `rounded_tokens`, `rounding_adj` to invoice export. Migration window scheduled during low-traffic.

billing-bot: Migration tasks queued: metering_precision_mig, invoice_field_add. Billing service maintenance: 2026-08-25 23:00 UTC. Expected <15m pipeline pause.

cs-bot: Heads-up for CS: prepare FAQ explaining why bills may show small rounding_adj amounts for many small requests. Template draft in docs link.

jamie: Pricing rationale: customers reported small per-request rounding anomalies at scale; this reduces customer-perceived noise and improves unit-cost accuracy. No change to list pricing per token. Existing invoices unaffected until enforcement date.

priya: Action items: - Eng: implement collector + pipeline changes, add webhook fields `billing.rounding_adj`. - Data: run backfill to estimate typical rounding_adj per org and flag if > $5/mo. - CS: customer templates. - Legal: review invoice descriptor text.

callum: We'll post a breaking-change note for any self-serve integrations that consume raw usage CSVs. Add a version number to CSV header.

billing-bot: Noted. Emitting webhook event `billing.rounding_migration.notice` during rollout.

jamie: I'll schedule a cross-functional sync for next Tue to review customer samples. Thanks.

priya: ack :thumbsup:
